reviews.text:
I had no experience with Xero going into this, but Sabrina made the setup process straightforward and easy to follow. She answered my questions quickly, showed me best practices, and explained multiple ways to handle different tasks while also giving practical recommendations on what she would do herself.

Very helpful overall, and I would absolutely work with her again if I need additional help in the future.

I hadn't found a great option for QBO to Xero migrations but decided to look again because this client had historical data that we really needed to be imported. I looked into Xendoo and it seemed too good to be true. I scheduled a call and 48 hours later, I was on another call with Sabrina at Xendoo reviewing the migration. It really was that simple. I'm ecstatic about how this went and will be using them for every migration moving forward. Thanks!

Wow, what could I hope for that Sabrina didn't provide? She is knowledgeable, communicates well, unpretentious on the limits of her knowledge. She understands the goals of the business well. Practical minded. Empathetic. Provides good workarounds.

Yes, Xendoo is on my radar, uncontested for future services!

Sabrina made transferring ALL my business information from QB to Xero easy and quick! She answered my questions, walked me thru important steps and got me started. The best part was this service was provided in my Xero plan.

We were assisted by Sabrina during a changeover from Quickbooks to Xero. Sabrina was helpful and knowledgeable. She took the time to explain different aspects, and made the process smooth. Thank you for a great service!

Sabrina was very knowledgeable about the Xero software and very quickly showed me specifics that would save me a ton of time. I love that they have you share your screen with them and you navigate through the software yourself. It's a great way to learn - and actually remember the steps!

★★★★★

Xendoo is already delivering service excellence.

I had my onboarding call today and was genuinely impressed. Not only was the process smooth, clear, and actually helpful—but the founder, Lil Roberts, personally joined the call. That level of involvement from the top says everything about how seriously Xendoo takes service.

Their team—Jasmine, Jada, and Sabrina—was sharp, organized, and on it. They broke down exactly how their online bookkeeping and online accounting workflows operate week to week, what to expect from my dedicated accountant, and how they keep communication tight. It feels like plugging into a real system, not just outsourcing work into a void.

They also extended me six months free of their Xendoo Insights integration, and even small touches like sending out a welcome box matter more than people think. It shows intention.

If you're looking for an accounting partner that shows up, communicates clearly, and actually cares about your business running clean, Xendoo is absolutely worth it.

We have been customers with Xendoo for three years and our Senior Accountant is Kacey Benson.
Kacey is friendly, professional and very competent. We appreciate his weekly check-ins and never ending patience.
Recently our Franchise has moved from Xendoo to another accounting provider and we choose to stay with Xendoo because of our relationship with Kacey.
Kacey does an excellent job and we appreciate him.
Working with Kacey at Xendoo has been an absolute pleasure.  He gets our business and always has our books ready in time.  We are so lucky to have him on our team!

Hired Xendoo for both our USA C Corp Inc & LLC businesses, plus our personal tax returns, as foreign nationals from the UK Louis and David made it stress fee and provided a fast competitive and reliable trusted service.  If you are a foreign national needing a firm who understands the confusion you are feeling once you are faced with the change in accounting, tax and compliance laws in the USA, I highly highly recommend David and Louis at Xendoo.

I hired this firm to prepare and file my 2023 taxes. I later started receiving multiple notices from the IRS and the State of North Carolina, including one stating that my 2023 return was not filed.
When I first contacted the firm about IRS notices related to Form 8962, I was told that the issue was on my end and was sent a revised page with instructions to mail it to the IRS myself. When I asked follow-up questions about how this might affect the rest of my return and what I owed, my concerns were not really addressed, and over time my emails stopped getting responses.
Since then, I’ve received repeated IRS correspondence, identity verification issues, a penalty notice from NC, and confirmation that my 2023 return was not filed. I have also noticed that I am unable to remove my stored payment information from their website and have requested that it be deleted.
I have asked the firm to explain what happened, refund the fees I paid, and help correct the situation. As of the time of this review, it has not been resolved. I’m sharing my experience so others can be aware and carefully verify that their returns have actually been filed and that any issues are followed up on.

Sabrina was wonderful in guiding me through the complex process of converting my past QuickBooks data and converting it into Xero. I’m so thrilled to be simplifying of my accounting and this was an excellent first step.
Sabrina was super helpful. I'm excited to start using this product after having so many diffulcties with Quickbooks for years.

Sabrina was amazing to work with during my conversion from QuickBooks to Xero. She patiently answered all of my questions and always made time for me when I needed help. Her support made the whole process so much smoother, and I’m very grateful for her expertise. The conversion was a success and the help before, during, and after was wonderful. Highly recommend!
The Xendoo representative, Sabrina, was very knowledgeable and cordial during our call.  She gave me some good tips and made sure I was well set. Highly recommend!
They do great work especially Natasha Mahajan who I have worked with for years is super professional. Highly recommended!!!

Sabrina was fantastic!
My bookkeeping practices are disastrous and embarrassing. However she easily answered all of my questions, was patient, explained things clearly, guided me through every step & is always eager to follow through with additional clarification if necessary. Plus her follow up notes & recordings are incredibly helpful. I feel like she has brought me to a place where I no longer feel overwhelmed & now finally motivated to stay here.

The team at Xendoo is just flat out excellent. From bookkeeping. tax services (business and personal), general accounting, and providing business advice...simply top notch. Thank you to Louis, Natasha, and Mario for making our experiences with Xendoo as good as we could hope for.

Sabrina was incredibly helpful! She answered all of my questions and pointed out a big issue I didn’t even realize I had! I feel a lot more confident using my bookkeeping software after our conversation.

I run a business, and keeping up with the accounting used to give me constant headaches. With multiple credit cards, withdrawals, deposits, and charges going in and out, it felt impossible to stay organized. Ever since I started working with Xendoo, everything has been so much smoother. They’ve helped me get my finances in order and made it easy to stay on top of everything. I’m on the plan that also includes year-end tax filing for the business, and it’s been one of the best decisions I’ve made. Xendoo is reliable, professional, and has truly made my life easier. Highly recommend them to any business owner looking for peace of mind.

I cannot recommend Xendoo highly enough! My accountant Jared and tax preparer David are incredible to work with.

Jared reconciles my books super quickly each month and is really responsive (which, for an accountant, should earn him a medal on his own).

David is incredibly knowledgeable on tax strategy, and somehow always finds ways to save me money or even get me a refund (which is wild because I always expect to owe money at tax time).

I've been with Xendoo for 3 years now, and I can't imagine going anywhere else!

We have been using Xendoo for Accounting Since 2018 with our four different companies and we think we work well together and they deliver on our expectations.  Tax planning and completing the tax returns via the Xendoo portal, makes life easier on all, so communication is streamlined and less back and forth.  Reaching our assigned team members has been easy.  Look forward for continued help from Mario and Louis!  We thank them for what they do for us.

We switched to Xendoo a few years ago. We've never regretted the move. Xendoo does excellent work - both corporate and personal - for us. Our corporate accountant - Tanesha Webb - is always on top of our account and actively communicates with us. She does a great job for our company.

Sabrina helped me out and got more done in 30 minutes than I ever could have in several hours! She was friendly and knowledgable, and was great to work with. It's great to know I can get professional help quickly when I get stuck with something on Xero!

Our Accounting Manager of many years relocated. Instead of re-hiring for the position we decided to manage remotely using Xendoo. Jada, Rae and Ala have been incredible to work with. Apparently nothing exceeds their capabilities.

They suggested Xero and bill.com as replacements for our legacy software and we couldn't be happier. The transition has been quick and flawless.

Highly recommend this company and Team.

I had the pleasure of receiving software assistance from Sabrina Biliky.  Sabrina was fantastic!!  She was able to troubleshoot my bank/credit card accounts and correct the downloading issues of some transactions which were not linking correctly.  Thank you so much Sabrina for your expertise!!

We have worked with Kamilah at Xendoo for a couple of years now. She has been an excellent resource and is amazing at providing our bookkeeping. Tax time is simple with Louis and Mario handling the accounting. Thank you to the entire team!
We are very happy with Xendoo and with Natasha as our accountant. She is responsive, helpful, and always makes the process smooth. Highly recommend!

Natasha is the best best best bestestest rep ever to be assigned to my company. Been with her about 2 years now and when it comes to dependability she is that. Love the company, i think all business owners need Xendoo for book keeping. Best peace of mind but Natasha she is amazing!

I can't say enough good things about Ruth and the Xendoo team! My books have never been this accurate, and having the ability to schedule calls directly on Ruth’s calendar at any time has made managing my finances so much easier. She is incredibly professional, knowledgeable, and responsive.

I also use Xendoo’s Tax Department, and it makes everything seamless—! I  Highly recommend Xendoo and especially Ruth for top-notch service.

Xendoo has been very helpful to my business.  They have kept my bookeeping clean and organized and they are very affordable for a small business like myself.  My account rep, Javiera Gando has been especially helpful.  She took my account over and things were a bit of a mess to due to my invoicing software not properly syncing into my financial software.  She had an incredible amount of patience with all of that and helped me figure it all out.  Her communication is terrific, and she has given me peace of mind that my books are in order every month!  I highly recommend them!

Even though I wasn’t the right fit for their expertise, Denny did a fantastic job of making sure I felt heard and understood. They gave me clear, solid advice to move forward with, and did me a true favor by recommending that I get the service I needed for a lower rate elsewhere(who does that?!). So appreciative for the integrity of this team in today’s world.🩷🙏🏻

Nothing short of AMAZING from Xendoo. I have been with them for 5 years. They have been with us from the time we made little to nothing - high figures. You will not be disappointed. What I like most is how they grow with you, when your business grows. You don't have to know tax laws or loop-holes for them to apply to you. If you use Xendoo, speak with your bookkeeper every month. Laura, Louis and Mario are business geniuses. The entire company's platform and service makes a difference. Yes, I know it seems expensive, but trust me you will thank yourself at the end, especially if you have a business and personal which incorporates many assets occurring.

My small business has been with Xendoo for more than 3 years, and I highly recommend their services. We went through a few bookkeepers during that time, with mixed results, so I recognize that the experience is dependent upon the team assigned to you, as at any accounting service. In our case Ruth Roman has delivered a very positive experience, and on more than one occasion has gone above and beyond to customize to our unique needs as a startup. So far, we haven't been able to surprise her, and we've thrown some curveballs her way.

Your experience with Xendoo will completely depend on which accountant you are assigned. Rae Robinson has been an absolute pleasure to work with - she's on top of everything and makes my life much easier!
Sabrina was super helpful and really good at guiding me across the dashboard. The changes made were crucial for my business and I am very helpful. Thanks Sabrina…you are the best! Keep it up!

Xendoo is the absolute best company I have worked with. The bookkeeping service is flawless and support is simply the best. Tanesha is a bookkeeping genius. I can't stress enough how skilled she is. I have to do Zero work with her managing my books. They always respond quickly to anything I need. Books are always accurate and the reports are extremely helpful to running my business. When it comes time to filing taxes, they have you covered. They are tax professionals that know everything about business taxes and you can be assured every possible deduction will be utilized. I used to be stressed out every year during tax time but now I am worry free. They are 100% USA based which is a huge deal. I’ve been with Xendoo for 4 years now and I can say it was a smart choice. I highly recommend Xendoo!

I have been with Xendoo for nearly three years, and I have to say I am extremely happy with my bookkeeper, Rae Robinson. She is one of the best service representatives I have ever dealt with across all service industries. Rae is very professional and loves her job!
Sabrina Biliky was amazing. She expertly solved all of my Xero problems and was extremely efficient and clear. Best accounting experience I have ever had.

I have been with Xendoo since March, 2023 and I have been very happy with the service I have received.  They have taken away a lot of the headache!  My bookkeeper, Javiera, is very professional, knowledgeable, and consistent.  The accountants are also very thorough and knowledgeable.  I am glad I went with Xendoo!

Xendoo and my Accountant, Stacey Williams, have been great for me and my small business.  All of my monthly bookkeeping needs are met within my needed timeframes and Stacey is always super responsive and very friendly!  Their website is super user friendly and access to all needed documents are easily attainable.

We are having an excellent experience with our bookkeeper, Stacey. She is extremely responsible, focused, and always available to clarify our doubts with patience and professionalism. Her attention to detail and commitment to keeping our accounting in order make all the difference. We highly recommend her work without hesitation!

Taxes and accounting can be stressful, but Xendoo and specially Baisgy Alvarez makes everything so much easier. She always sends documents on time and is incredibly patient with my schedule. As a busy business owner, I have a lot on my plate—but she simplifies everything, from filling out charts to requesting information and following instructions.

When our business was impacted by a fire on the floor above us, Xendoo even reduced our fee for that month. That kind of support means so much—during hard times, every dollar counts.

Thank you, Xendoo, for the kindness and professionalism. And thank you, Baisgy, for being such a reliable and supportive accountant!

Choosing Xendoo to manage my bookkeeping and taxes has been one of the best decisions I've made for my business. My bookkeeper, Elizabeth Marino, is fantastic—she's proactive and always stays ahead of everything. Highly recommend.
I love my Xendoo team!  They worked with me through every step to get what I needed.  Fantastic! You won't regret it.

Great support with solving my issues with Xero as a new user, first time business owner and extremely novice bookkeeper. Live support from Derica and Jana was exactly what I needed. They were clear and supportive. Would love to see more live support and partnership with Xero and Xendoo in the future.

Great team and great help, Jada and D'Erica did an amazing job in getting our questions answered and getting the help we needed.
If you have the opportunity to work with them directly, or even if you are just making use of the free consult through Xero - we highly recommend them!

It’s been such a blessing to have Javiera as our accountant. She has worked hard to clean up errors made prior to our account being reassigned to her. She’s wonderful at providing detailed explanations to all of my questions, and being open to discussion if I think something should be booked differently.  She is an essential part of our business!

Xendoo has been a lifesaver!  Their service is fantastic, especially considering the affordable price. They've taken a huge weight off my shoulders by handling all my Shopify store's bookkeeping needs. They're incredibly professional, efficient, and always available to answer questions.  Xendoo is truly a value-add for any small business – totally worth it!

Great company, been using them more than half a decade now.
Highly recommend Natasha Mahajan for your personal accountant. She's always on top of the work, very polite, and super knowledgeable.

Rae Robinson was a God send to me from Xendoo! She was not only on top of all of my corrections, she helped educate me on how to manage my accounting software moving forward. She was so efficient and I truly appreciated her efforts to get me back on track!

My support concierge, D'Erica Thompson, was extremely patient and helpful with me during our virtual session. We were
switching from another accounting software to Xero and I was having some issues with managing our business accounts. Ms. Thompson was able to quickly determine where I wet wrong in the Xero reconciliation process and walked me through how to fix my old errors as well as how to prevent them in the future. I feel more confident using this software now and believe it will meet our business needs moving forward. I am appreciative of Ms. Thompson's help.

Matt Johnson has been an excellent bookkeeper who proactively seeks guidance and asks clarifying questions to ensure accurate records, rather than simply reacting to audit findings. His attention to detail and forward-thinking approach have been outstanding.

I would highly recommend both Xendoo and Matt Johnson for bookkeeping services. Additionally, Louis Goldenberg serves as an excellent CPA who provides strategic guidance to optimize business performance. Together, they deliver incredible value and comprehensive financial support.

Laura Harvey has been our company accountant at Xendoo for three years . She has been great pto work pwith, always willing to go the extra mile.  I highly recommend Xendoo to any company needing accounting services.
Sabrina was very knowledgeable and helped me with the complex issues that I had. Highly recommend working with her anytime. Thank you very much, Sabrina! :)

Do not trust "GOOD" reviews. These guys are idiots!
One of the founding members of this organization who has tons of initials after his name and titles worked with me.
During an audit in which he was "helping " me, he actually told me to pay off an asset.
Who pays off an asset?
After Xendoo almost ruined my business, I went to another CPA. He told me to move the "asset" from ASSETS to OWNER EQUITY. It would cost some money in taxes and would not ruin the company.
I did it and the audit we were going through finished immediately. The auditor literally told me afterword, off the record, and after I fired Xendoo, that was exactly what we needed to do. Move the "Asset" to Owner Equity and fire Xendoo.
Really they are not worthy of even 1 star.
Working with Stacey Williams has been a great experience. My financials are timely and accurate.

A True Asset to Our Business
We have had the pleasure of working with Ruth R. (Xendoo) for several years, and we couldn’t be more satisfied with their expertise and professionalism. Ruth has been instrumental in managing our QuickBooks, ensuring that our financial records are accurate, up-to-date, and well-organized.
Ruth R. consistently goes above and beyond, demonstrating exceptional attention to detail and a deep understanding of accounting principles. She has helped streamline our bookkeeping processes, troubleshoot complex financial issues, and provide valuable insights that have improved our overall financial health.
What sets Ruth apart is her responsiveness and willingness to educate us on best practices, making financial management smoother and less stressful. Her patience, dedication, and problem-solving skills make them an invaluable part of our team.
We highly recommend Ruth (Xendoo) to anyone seeking a reliable and knowledgeable accountant manager/Accounting Services. Their expertise and professionalism have been a game-changer for our business!

I received Xendoo as a referral from A2X and called in for an initial consultation and I felt very comfortable to move forward.  A few days later I was assigned an accountant, Dylan.  He is extremely knowledgeable, friendly, and got my entire five months accounting up to date in a week.  I can't say enough good things and recommend this company to all business.  We will now know each month how we are doing financially with certainty.

The Xendoo team is fantastic! Excellent customer service and expertise. This is the perfect solution for a startup, early stage company or small and medium sized business. You can outsource your A/P, bookkeeping and financial reports to them and they deliver quality reports on a date certain each month at a reasonable price. What I really loved was how proactive they were and how responsive they were. They really helped me research and get to the bottom of certain issues without nickel and diming me. I loved working with Ruth Roman, our bookkeeper, and the whole Xendoo team. I loved the experience and would definitely use them for my other clients.

Bob Fitts
Interim/Fractional COO/CFO

Working with Xendoo has been an excellent experience.  More precisely, my assigned accountant is very well suited, she knows my business, was able to answer all my questions. It is a pleasure working with Xendoo and I would highly recommend to anyone who would benefit from having this service free up more time to run their business.

I had to reschedule, and then they did as well  a few times, but when I had my session with Jada, she was delightful,  patient and made sure ALL my questions were answered. We ran out of time in our original session due to me not logging in twice before our , I had to authenticate my account. Jada offered to schedule more time later that day, to insure I got set up to the level I needed. That is very rare these days and was so appreciated. Jada is a rare gem!

I've had the pleasure of meeting with Steven from Xendoo and it was immensely helpful. As someone with less than a month of experience with Xero, it was great to have an expert look through my setup and confirm that I'm on the right track. Thanks again Steven!
Working with Rae Robinson from Xendoo is a pleasure. She is highly available, very efficient and works with our priorities. She is part of the team, we love working with her.

I am so thank for Kamilah at Xendoo. I was so behind on my bookkeeping before finding the team at Xendoo. They are so responsive, considerate and beyond helpful. 10/10 recommend using their services. Thank you, Kamilah!!

We absolutely LOVE Xendoo! Completely changed the accounting structure of our business. Juan is wonderful and even completed two years of catch up for us! The whole system is seamless from start to finish and very affordable. Highly recommend!

Xendoo has been a LIFE SAVER for us. We originally had a huge project to clean up more than 2 years of our books after we discovered our previous firm had misreported them. We had such a complex subscription and revenue structure that most accounting firms didn’t want to touch us. Xendoo took us on as a client, and completed the project within 2 weeks. They paid very close attention to detail, were extremely responsive (evenings, weekends, etc.) and got everything done perfectly. Since then, it’s been smooth sailing and we could not be happier. Thank you Xendoo!!

I had a virtual call with Jada Williamson, and she fully explained how the platform works. Every question I had, she was able to answer thoroughly. We shared screens, and she helped me make some new classification accounts specific to our business. This has all the features of QB, but is more cost effective. Great job, Jada

Rae Robinson is a WONDERFUL bookkeeper.  We have been working together for several years now, and I am so appreciative of her patience, diligence, and kindness, and yes, of course her ability to keep our books well organized.  Thank you, Rae!

Brenda at Xendoo was incredible to work with. She was professional, kind, quick to respond, and most importantly took great care of our bookkeeping! We would most certainly recommend Xendoo to anyone!
I have had zero experience with Xero and Sabrina was very patient and kind with me.  I really appreciated her knowledge and her patience.

I can not say enough about how great xendoo has been for my business. Both my accountant and book keeper are fantastic. The price of their services is very cost effective. I get a free subscription to Xero. They integrate with all of my different software's for seamless accounting. I highly recommend this firm!

If I could give them negative stars, I would.

This business trains its staff to be masters of deception.

I’ve never experienced anything like this—speaking to a representative who bragged about operating in 13 countries and 48 U.S. states. But when I asked for specific locations, they could only provide a supposed 15,000-square-foot headquarters. A quick search on Google Maps revealed the truth: there’s no physical presence, just a remote scamming operation.

The lies didn’t stop there. When asked about encryption, the agent stumbled, claiming, “Maybe we have like 2K bits,” and then confidently proclaimed their encryption was impenetrable by even the most advanced technologies. It was absurd and insulting, as if they thought I’d blindly fall for it.

The representative’s smug laughter as he pushed these blatant lies was disgusting. Save yourself the trouble and avoid this shady organization at all costs.

Baisgy was awesome. She took the time to provide me with detail information. I never felt rush when I delt with her. She even took the time provide me with information on my QBO when I had to transition to another provider. Excellent service Baisgy!

Not for us.  We sell air compressors and other equipment and have a challenge with knowing where we stand day to day with cash. For us, we tend to sell an item, but not see an invoice for days or even weeks. With unknown costs, it is hard to feel comfortable with our bank balance.

When I reached out to Xendoo, they were certain that they could help. Unfortunately, the way they do bookkeeping does not fit our business. They basically take each months incoming transactions and subtract the outgoing transactions to get your profit. However, when you have thousands of dollars in costs that you haven't received invoices for, there will be huge swings month to month.

I was willing to let things go to the end of the year until they overpaid our sales tax to the state by over $3700, which we still have not received back a month later.

I don't doubt that they can help other businesses, but it just didn't work for us.

Lee has been working on my books for 5 yrs and we hit an issue with reconciling my books. She was able to account for the discrepancies which were due to application functionality and get my books back in order. Thank you Lee for the years of support!
Rae Robinson is my bookkeeper at Xendoo. She is great at helping grow my knowledge of accounting and running that portion of my business.

Great accounting firm that helped us out a ton! We thought we were going to do our own bookkeeping but we got way behind and they helped us get caught up for a very fair price. Communication is great. Always a timely response to all emails. Phone calls could also be scheduled if needed. Overall great to work with!

Had a brief intro meeting with Steven to assist with Xero. Very efficient and gets a lot covered in 30 mins. Just set up another appointment for 1 hour with Steven. Will continue to work with him for my xero needs.

With Xendoo’s help, I’ve been able to save time, taxes, and frustration of being overwhelmed.  My bookkeeping team at Xendoo is always available to help and on point with delivering my monthly reports to me each month.  Starting a business and figuring out what tax forms need to be completed and when is challenging.  They have helped me with my Amazon quarterly filings that I wouldn't have known to do without their guidance.
It's super easy to create and track invoices on your account page.  Everything about your account page is easily accessible and all your files are easily accessible for future reference.
Any business looking to relieve stress related to bookkeeping and accounting, Xendoo is your solution.
Our bookkeeper, Ruth, has been excellent. She is patient with all my questions and does a great job keeping our books clean so I can focus on other areas of the business.

I just signed up with Xendoo for my bookkeeping and tax filing. I like the level of service they have been providing. I was previously  with 1800 accountant and QuickBooks live bookkeeper and was not satisfied with their services.
I’d definitely recommend Xendoo for anyone out there looking for an accounting firm.

I am stunned by the level of service I received from everyone at Xendoo, starting with the CEO, who was the person who answered the phone the first time I called because she hated customers to be on hold. I also can't believe the price to do our corporate taxes, and to do a fantastic job.  This company seriously has a customer for life.

There is no way this firm could have legitimate reviews. They completely destroyed my books for two companies. With one swipe their “quick clean up” deleted all transactions that were input throughout the year and even changed the books back into the previous year where they were closed And had taxes completed. This type of service cost me over $7k so far to try and repair my books. If you have a decent size company with 10 or more employees do not use this service as they will put you out of business.
2 separate business working with Xendoo and same positive experience each time!  Highly recommend this company and their services.  Ask for Brenda as your CPA, she's great.

Xendoo proposes top services and reactivity and guys are very professional and nice too. It's a pleasure to work with. It's been for 2,5 years they are my CPA company and they manage my different offline businesses with a professional way. As I'm not US Citizen, Xendoo also takes care to report in IRS all related stuffs with my country . Keep going guys!

Jada was so very helpful in clearing my doubts with the Xero platform. She was very very patient and understood my onboarding problems with Xero.  For a phone call that was suppose to last 30 minutes, she devoted almost an hour on explaining  and solving my issues.  Superb job Jada !!
I had the opportunity to work with Derica and Jada as part of Xero support and they were very friendly, patient and helpful clarifying my doubts and helping me successfully balance my bookkeeping.

I had a zoom call with Jada.  She explained how Xero works, and gave some insights into how to convert from QuickBooks to Xero.  In a lot of ways the two platforms do the same thing, but as a non-accountant, Xero is just easier for me to understand.  They are very well organized, with visuals that help make reconciling transactions simpler to understand.  I appreciate Jada's thorough explanation in a simple, yet insightful way.
Jada was very knowledgable and efficient. She ascertained my business needs in xero like a pro. Most of all, she was a joy to work with. I appreciated her patience and encouragement.
Great Value received.  Stacey (Bookkeeping) has very good attention to detail and keeps me on schedule with my monthly reporting.
We love Elizabeth! She is very on top of things and answers any of our questions promptly. It is a pleasure working witih her.
Game changing for us as a client.  Literally feels like we have an entire finance & accounting team!   Oh and by the way - they are really nice too - we love Xendoo.

I am very Happy with the personal one on one with Xendoo.
All the way here in Hawaii, I feel so important, My needs and questions are handled with care and very timely! The work done is very good and I feel found!
We at Patticakes Bakery LLC. Love Xendoo & are so very happy you found us & we found you!!

P.S. Extra Thank You to Davinia & Louis :)

Aloha..................

Patti

If there is an option to give them 0 I would do it.
I subscribed to trial, nobody has ever contacted me and nobody has opened Xero during the trial period.
When I contacted them they told it is for them a small job.
But the price is the same.
They do nothing of what they claim they would do.
Bookkeeping - they just reconcile items under Unknown and if you want full reconciliation you have to pay additionally even if they sell the service of bookkeeping under the package that you have already paid.
They did not want to do anything about the sales tax even if they claimed it is covered by the package.
In one word - terrible!
